claims.text: Machine-learning-based modeling can predict high-temperature oxidation behavior in high-entropy alloys.
Machine-learning-based modeling can predict phase stability in high-entropy alloys.
The proposed method applies to high-entropy alloys spanning different compositions and microstructures.
Precipitation structures are structural mediators relevant to the proposed prediction method.
Grain refinement is a structural mediator relevant to the proposed prediction method.
Interface engineering is a structural mediator relevant to the proposed prediction method.
Alloy composition and microstructure have complex relationships with high-temperature behavior.
Machine-learning-based modeling improves prediction of high-temperature oxidation resistance relative to traditional characterization methods.
Machine-learning-based modeling improves prediction of phase stability relative to traditional characterization methods.
Traditional characterization methods have limitations under high-temperature conditions.
The accuracy of machine-learning predictions can be evaluated by comparison with experimental oxidation and phase-stability results.
